menus.name: A mano a mano menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; its dishes can also be ordered à la carte

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, which takes card details to guarantee the table, or through the restaurant's contact form.
cancellation: Cancel at least 48 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged €100 per person to the card given when booking. Tables are held for 30 minutes after the booked time.
walkIns: La Terrazza, the cocktail bar on the terrace over the harbour, serves aperitivi from 6pm and can be booked on SevenRooms.
notice: Closed for the winter from 1 November 2026 (no tables on its booking page until spring 2027)
